long_biography.plain_text:
Lalo entered watchmaking through a family already active in manufacturing and distribution. His father drew him into the trade, while his grandmother remained involved in reviewing collections. In 1994 he reestablished a historic Swiss watch brand in the United States, developing a private group around design, production, television shopping, retail and licensed collections.

The company later broadened its brand portfolio and invested in digital commerce. As controlling shareholder and chief executive, Lalo combined product direction with ownership and board roles. A Formula 2 investment added a second operating platform; by 2025, Lalo chaired and owned the racing team while a separate executive managed daily competition.
